;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]]
**Coalition [[warplane]]s carry out an [[Airstrike|air raid]] on the [[Yemen]]i capital [[Sanaa]], bombing the [[Presidential Palace (Yemen)|Presidential Palace]] compound, a [[military school]] and [[airbase]] adjacent to [[Sanaa International Airport]]. The [[Houthi movement|Houthi]]-run [[Almasirah]] TV channel says 70 horses were killed in the raid on the school. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20200330-airstrikes-hit-houthi-held-yemeni-capital-sanaa/ (Middle East Monitor)]
*[[Somali Civil War]], [[Somali Civil War (2009–present)]]
**Abdisalan Hassan, governor of the [[Nugal, Somalia|Nugal region]], is killed in a suicide bombing. [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] claims responsibility. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/03/somali-governor-killed-al-shabab-suicide-bomb-attack-200330090409681.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[USA Rugby]] files for [[Chapter 11, Title 11, United States Code|chapter 11 bankruptcy]] citing "insurmountable financial constraints" amid the coronavirus pandemic. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2020/mar/30/usa-rugby-files-for-bankruptcy-as-coronavirus-takes-toll-on-game (''The Guardian'')]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]], [[2020 Hubei lockdowns]]
**[[Wuhan]], the epicenter of the [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] pandemic, reopens its stores and shopping centers. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/money/2020/03/30/wuhan-stores-shopping-malls-reopen-after-weeks-battling-coronavirus/5087115002/ (''USA Today'')]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[Premier of Ontario|Premier]] [[Doug Ford]] extends the province's state of emergency for another two weeks. [https://toronto.ctvnews.ca/ontario-premier-doug-ford-extends-state-of-emergency-for-another-two-weeks-1.4874408 (CTV News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Panama]]
****[[Panama]]'s Ministry of Health reports a total of 989 cases of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] in the country, of which 24 people have died. [https://www.tvn-2.com/nacionales/Suben-muertos-contagiados-COVID-19-Panama_0_5544195576.html (TVN)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[U.S. state and local government response to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
*****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York City]]
******The [[USNS Comfort (T-AH-20)|USNS ''Comfort'']] arrives in [[New York City]] to relieve the area's hospitals of non-coronavirus patients. [https://thehill.com/policy/defense/490136-navy-hospital-ship-arrives-in-new-york (''The Hill'')]
******The [[USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center]] in [[Queens]], New York City, will be converted into a temporary 350-bed [[field hospital]] to treat overflow patients from other hospitals in New York. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/queens-stadium-to-be-converted-into-temporary-hospital-in-coronavirus-fight-11585605068 (''Wall Street Journal'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Virginia]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Maryland]]
*****[[Governor of Maryland|Maryland Governor]] [[Larry Hogan]] and [[Governor of Virginia|Virginia Governor]] [[Ralph Northam]] issue [[stay-at-home orders]]. [[Virginia]]'s stay-at-home order will remain in effect until June 10. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/hogan-northam-coronavirus-stay-home-orders/2020/03/30/5f36e146-722f-11ea-85cb-8670579b863d_story.html (''Washington Post'')]   
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]]
****[[Mexico]] declares a national health emergency and extends the suspension of all non-essential activities until April 30. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-mexico/mexico-declares-health-emergency-as-coronavirus-death-toll-rises-idUSKBN21I05K (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****Japanese comedian [[Ken Shimura]] dies from [[pneumonia]] several days after being diagnosed with COVID-19. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/culture/2020/03/30/entertainment-news/comedian-ken-shimura-dies-hospitalized-coronavirus/#.XoGFBYgzZhE (''The Japan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
****[[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] and some of his cabinet members self-quarantine after an aide tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/netanyahu-to-go-into-quarantine-after-aide-tests-positive/1785026 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Syria]]
****The [[government of Syria|government]] reports the country's first death from COVID-19. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-52100372 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] begins a nationwide disinfection to help curb the spread of COVID-19. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/malaysia-to-start-nationwide-disinfection-efforts-to-prevent-coronavirus-spread (''Straits Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Fernando Simón]], Director of the Center for Coordination of Health Alerts and Emergencies of the [[Ministry of Health (Spain)|Spanish Ministry of Health]], becomes the second member of the Technical Committee to test positive for COVID-19. [https://www.rtve.es/alacarta/videos/noticias-24-horas/fernando-simon-da-positivo-coronavirus/5548112/ (RTVE)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark]]
****[[Prime Minister of Denmark|Prime Minister]] [[Mette Frederiksen]] says that the country will lift lockdowns after [[Easter]] if COVID-19 cases and death numbers remain stable. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronaviirus-denmark-idUSKBN21H2LY (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[Department of Health and Social Care]] reports 180 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing the [[United Kingdom]]'s death toll to 1,415. [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-another-159-people-die-after-testing-positive-in-england-11965742 (Sky News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[France]] reports 418 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the country's death toll to 3,024 and 44,550 cases. [https://metro.co.uk/2020/03/30/coronavirus-deaths-france-pass-3000-largest-daily-jump-12480628/?ito=cbshare (''Metro'')]
****Former [[List of presidents of the Republic of the Congo|President]] of the [[People's Republic of the Congo]] [[Joachim Yhombi-Opango]] dies from COVID-19 at a hospital in [[Neuilly-sur-Seine]]. He is the first state leader (former or current) to have died from COVID-19. [https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/coronavirus-deces-de-l-ex-president-congolais-yhombi-opango-20200330 (''Le Figaro'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Botswana]]
****[[Botswana]] reports their first confimed cases of COVID-19. Health Minister [[Lemogang Kwape]] says the three patients are currently in quarantine and had recently travelled to Britain and [[Thailand]]. [https://news.trust.org/item/20200330172800-r44d6/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Libya]]
****The [[Government of National Accord]] (GNA) frees 466 prisoners from jails in [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]] to prevent the spread of COVID-19. The GNA also announces an extended [[curfew]] from 2pm to 7am in the areas it controls. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/03/libya-frees-450-prisoners-stem-spread-coronavirus-200330093545745.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Law and crime
*The [[Singer Laren]] museum says that the [[Vincent van Gogh]] painting ''[[The Parsonage Garden at Nuenen]]'' was stolen in a raid. [https://apnews.com/e635b833e60dfcb01351752976d818df (AP News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics]]; [[COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary]]
**[[Hungarian Parliament|Parliament]] votes 137 to 53 in favor of passing legislation to create [[State of emergency#Hungary|a state of emergency]] without a time limit, grant [[Prime Minister of Hungary|Prime Minister]] [[Viktor Orbán]] the ability to rule by decree, suspend the parliament with no elections, and establish prison sentences for spreading fake news and leaving quarantine. [https://www.dw.com/en/hungary-passes-law-allowing-viktor-orban-to-rule-by-decree/a-52956243 (DW)]

;Sports
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]]
**After getting postponed a week before, the [[2020 Summer Olympics]] has been rescheduled to July 23, 2021, while the [[2020 Summer Paralympics]] is now taking place for August 24, 2021. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2020/mar/30/tokyo-olympics-to-start-in-july-2021-after-coronavirus-rescheduling (''The Guardian'')]
